title: Model European property-selected masks
changes: Add a source-authenticated lossless model for 35 property-selected EUR masks without capping guest selectors.
validation: An isolated Windows build and focused Wine test verified all 140 source bytes and boundaries, strict model validation, original reader indices inside and outside the projection, and three original metadata selectors.
limitations: These are conditional source-prefix tests; managed publication, ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
